source: SIGLO swarm-validated lumped Ar excitation total (Chen ref 22, the EEDF input) apportioned between R5 (Ar*, 4s) and R6 (Ar**, 4p) by BSR (B-spline R-matrix, Zatsarinny & Bartschat) 4p/(4s+4p) branching f(E)=0.25-0.36 in 13.5-30 eV, ->0.12 at 200 eV; benchmarked vs beam experiments (which give 4p share ~0.2-0.3), replacing the RDW ratio (f->0.68 at 20 eV, threshold-peaked theory known to overestimate). Two-level per Chen (3d/5s cascade reassigns through the total); R5+R6 == SIGLO exactly. Sources: SIGLO database, www.lxcat.net; BSR database, www.lxcat.net (retrieved 2026-07-30).
